t: You're looking at Affection, a sculpture by Joseph Hermon Cawthra. Cawthra lived from 1886 to 1971, and in his lifetime he was counted among the leading classical sculptors working in Britain. He was an English monumental sculptor who took on public monuments, war memorials and architectural sculpture. So this is the work of someone trusted with grand, lasting commissions, and it's worth a slow look at the carving.
